notes.title: Escape Everlit is Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]It's here. Finally.[/p][p][/p][p]20 months ago, I quit my job to do something fun.[/p][p]
Back then, I knew nothing about game development. I'd never had any formal training in art or music, nor solid end-to-end software engineering experience. All I had were a few unpublished short stories.[/p][p][/p][p]But I was a gamer with over 30 years under my belt. I believed I could make it—so I went all in. After 2,742 hours of joy, self-doubt, and simply, work, I present this point-n-click narrative-oriented adventure:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]9-10 hours of gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]4 playable protagonists trapped on a secret island[/p][/*][*][p]22 interconnected supporting characters[/p][/*][*][p]10,000+ lines of dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]5 distinct area maps[/p][/*][*][p]4-5 different endings
[/p][/*][/list][p]My goal from day one was to tell a unique, compelling, and grounded sci-fi mystery with an ensemble cast—a story with intricate structure that could only be told through the interactive medium of video games. This kept me going through the whole solo development, without a publisher or even outsourcing.[/p][p][/p][p]I can honestly say I've created something I'm satisfied with.[/p][p][/p][p]Players who participated in beta testing or tried the demo have also given many positive feedbacks: [i]"What an amazing story!" "Personally, I think the story is every bit as good as *** (well, an excellent game in this genre)" "There are so many unconventional creative mechanics" "The puzzle hints are really thoughtfully designed and user-friendly"[/i] and more.[/p][p][/p][p]If it can deliver a unique experience to you too, that would make it all worthwhile.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is now available on Steam with a 10% launch discount. Windows OS only.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106589/e882040e649ba422c19cfed05235d3670ce00661.png"][/img][/p][p](Almost all art and music assets were created using commercially licensed generative AI services. If you're interested in narrative adventure games but have concerns about the quality of AI-generated content, please try the demo. It's the first (approx.) 90 minutes of the game, and your save file carries over seamlessly to the full version.)[/p]

notes.title: Escape Everlit to launch on July 31st! Demo updated (save file compatible)!
notes.content:
[p]Hey there, I'm ash from Lantao Studio, a solo gamedev.[/p][p]
[/p][p]After a year and a half of development (2,700 full-time work hours), "Escape Everlit" is finally set to officially launch at the end of this month.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The beta testing process has garnered wonderful reviews, giving me confidence to say: "This sci-fi suspense interactive story has been told well." Although the dev time ended up being three times my initial estimate, seeing this unique work come together in its complete form makes every struggle in the creative process worthwhile.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The game previously participated in Steam's October Next Fest last year. (Yes, two more Next Fests have passed since then.) While the demo released at that time has remained available for the past nine months and I've made numerous adjustments based on collected feedback, the demo itself hasn't received any updates.[/p][p]
[/p][p]This updated demo, besides being more polished, covers roughly the same story section as before—the first chapter and the first half of the second chapter, approximately 1.5 hours of story setup. The full version runs about 9-10 hours.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Save files from the new demo are compatible with the full version, but not with the previous demo. After purchasing the full version, you can seamlessly load your final autosave from the demo to continue your journey.[/p][p]
[/p][p]I hope the new demo will help undecided players determine whether this game, which fully utilizes AI-generated art and music, meets their expectations. The demo will remain available indefinitely.[/p][p]
[/p][p]If you enjoy narrative/text-driven games, please give it a try. If you find it appealing, feel free to add to your wishlist—you'll receive a notification when it launches. Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Escape Everlit in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm ash, the solo dev behind Lantao Studio. My game "Escape Everlit" is participating in Steam's October Next Fest!

A demo of the game was released in late September, with about 90-120 minutes of gameplay, including the story prologue and most content of the first level. During Next Fest, I'll be periodically streaming pre-recorded full playthroughs of the demo on the store page to showcase a more detailed slice of the gaming experience.

If you tried the demo, please share your thoughts and suggestions on the Steam community forum. Thanks for your interest and support!

notes.title: Escape Everlit Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm ash, the solo dev behind lantao studio. After eight months of work, my first game Escape Everlit is releasing a demo.

The demo playtime is approximately 90-120 minutes, featuring the prologue and most content of the first level, 'Subway Station'. You can play as two of the four main characters. The demo is available on PC. It provides an overview of the story style and gameplay mechanics of Escape Everlit. This is the kind of narrative game best enjoyed at a leisurely pace. 

[b]This is a game that simply aims to tell a good story.[/b] Players will uncover 'what exactly happened' and 'what should I do' by walking around and interacting with the environment, as well as engaging in dialogues and making choices with various characters. That's the essence of it. If the plot makes you think 'I didn't expect that' while also feeling 'it does make sense', then I've achieved my goal - crafting an interesting, believable sci-fi mystery story.

[b]This is a story that could only be told through the medium of gaming.[/b] The core mechanic of 'character switching' is crucial: players need to control and combine the different personalities and approaches of the main characters, trying various possible actions to progress through the story and levels. Each different choice leads to new discoveries. (Due to narrative requirements and time constraints, this mechanic isn't fully showcased in the demo.)

After playing, whether opinions being positive or negative, you're more than welcome to leave a review or share your thoughts on the demo's store page. As this is my first game, your feedback is invaluable. The subsequent chapters and levels are still in development, so your opinions will influence the direction of both game development and storytelling.

Escape Everlit will join in the Steam Next Fest from October 14th to 21st. See you there!
